name: qa_institutional_momentum_proxy_ind
mutation: direct WQ FASTEXPR translation with industry neutralization
hypothesis: Price returns coordinated with volume changes, confirmed by positive intraday returns, may proxy sustainable institutional momentum.
expression: rank(ts_corr(ts_delta(close, 1) / close, ts_delta(volume, 1) / volume, 20) * ts_mean((close - open) / close, 5))
notes: Technical candidate; watch turnover and self-correlation.

name: qa_institutional_momentum_proxy_mkt
hypothesis: Price-volume coordination may survive without industry ranking if it captures microstructure pressure.
expression: rank(ts_corr(ts_delta(close, 1) / close, ts_delta(volume, 1) / volume, 20) * ts_mean((close - open) / close, 5))
notes: Compare against industry neutralization before promotion.

name: qa_gap_range_zscore_ind
mutation: normalize overnight gap by recent intraday range
hypothesis: Large overnight gaps relative to recent trading range may encode auction-driven information.
notes: Test sign sensitivity; may be continuation or reversal depending on market regime.

name: qa_gap_range_reversal_ind
mutation: reverse sign for gap mean-reversion test
hypothesis: Extreme overnight gaps relative to recent range may reverse after auction overreaction.
notes: Use as controlled sign test against qa_gap_range_zscore_ind.

name: qa_gap_acceptance_ind
mutation: combine overnight gap direction with intraday open-close acceptance
hypothesis: An overnight gap accepted by intraday price movement may contain more persistent information than a rejected gap.

name: qa_gap_acceptance_volweighted_ind
mutation: weight gap acceptance by abnormal volume
hypothesis: Gap acceptance on unusual volume may reflect more information-rich participation.
expression: rank((open / ts_delay(close, 1) - 1) * ((close - open) / open) * ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20))
notes: Higher complexity than plain gap acceptance; require better Fitness or lower correlation.

name: qa_range_deviation_continuation_ind
hypothesis: Range deviation may capture persistent volatility-structure information under noisy regimes.
notes: Can be risk exposure rather than alpha; compare with reversed sign.

name: qa_range_deviation_reversal_ind
hypothesis: High recent range deviation may indicate noisy overreaction and subsequent underperformance.

name: qa_clean_trend_liquidity_ind
parent: CleanTrend and liquidity re-rating appendix analysis
hypothesis: Short-horizon trend is more reliable when return volatility is low and liquidity participation improves.
notes: May correlate with momentum-volume alphas; check daily-return correlation.

name: qa_exhaustion_climax_reversal_ind
mutation: price displacement times volume intensity, reversed
hypothesis: Large price displacement on high relative volume can mark exhaustion and reversal.
notes: Crowded reversal family; submit only if Fitness and correlation are excellent.
